groups.heading: ADVANCED LIMIT
items: Sec 17 of MGNREGA mandates Gram Sabha monitoring and regular social audits of works within the Gram Panchayat.
CAUTION: Social audit means community verification of records, expenditure and outcomes — not merely departmental inspection.
Meghalaya enacted the Meghalaya Community Participation and Public Services Social Audit Act, 2017, widely cited as the first state social-audit law.
